name: Ludo
tagline: Ludo. Four seats fill as friends open your invite.
description:
Send the invite. The people who open it sit Red, Green, Yellow, and Blue — you only roll on your colour.

Each colour has four tokens. Roll a six to leave the yard. Race them clockwise around the board and up your own home stretch. Land on someone who is not on a start square and they go back to the yard. You stay. A six is another roll, unless you throw three in a row. An exact count takes a token home. First to get all four home wins.

On your own, pass the phone — two, three, or four colours, all on this device. A game in progress is saved; close it and Continue picks it up.

An unofficial port of Ludo by chukwumaijem.
